@graph.name: Pricing - ZenML
@graph.description: Priced per agent, not per seat. Your AI engineer starts at $39 a month for one agent, with your whole team included. Open source is free; on-prem is priced with you.

acceptedAnswer.text: An agent is anything you want your AI engineer to watch: its code, in one repo or several, and the traces it sends. Starter covers one, Team covers 5, and each one after that is $39 a month.

mainEntity.name: Why per agent and not per seat?

acceptedAnswer.text: Because everyone who knows what good looks like should be in it: engineers, product, and the domain experts who review sessions. A team of fifteen pays the same as a team of two.

mainEntity.name: Does the AI engineer cost extra?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. It's included on every hosted plan, up to the sessions it reads each month (1,000 on Starter, 10,000 on Team). Replays run with your own model keys, so those model costs stay on your bill, not ours.

mainEntity.name: What if we go over the sessions it reads?

acceptedAnswer.text: Nothing stops. Your AI engineer keeps reading a sample, and we'll tell you when the next plan makes sense.
The trial is full access and needs no credit card. When it ends, add a card and pick a plan. Nothing in your workspace changes except the billing. The open-source version stays free, forever.
Yes, on Enterprise. Your AI engineer runs inside your own cloud or on-prem, air-gapped if you need it, and can call your own LLM endpoint. It's priced with you, based on agents and deployment.

On hosted plans, your AI engineer runs in our cloud and reads traces from your tracing tool through keys you can revoke. Replays run on your own workers with your own keys. Self-hosted or on Enterprise on-prem, nothing leaves your infrastructure.

mainEntity.name: How is this different from Langfuse, Braintrust or LangSmith?

acceptedAnswer.text: They tell you what happened: traces you read, dashboards you check. Kitaru re-runs what happened. Your agent's real code executes again against the recorded world, so you can test your next change against your last thousand sessions before it ships. Kitaru also imports trace files exported from Langfuse, LangSmith, Braintrust, Logfire or Arize Phoenix, so your observability tool stays your system of record.

mainEntity.name: Do I need a separate subscription for ZenML?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, one subscription covers both. ZenML's managed tiers scale with pipeline executions; agents are priced per agent. Same control plane, same governance, one bill.

Yes. ZenML is open source and free to self-host; that's the Open Source plan. If you want the Pro control plane on your own infrastructure, Enterprise covers self-hosted and air-gapped deployment. Either way, ZenML stores only metadata: your data, artifacts and compute stay in your VPC end-to-end.

mainEntity.name: How is the Scale plan billed?

acceptedAnswer.text: By monthly pipeline executions per workspace. The slider on the Scale card above sets your tier, and projects and snapshots scale with it. Pick the tier that matches your run volume and move between tiers as you grow; there's no per-seat pricing.

mainEntity.name: What happens if I exceed my plan's executions?

acceptedAnswer.text: We don't cut you off mid-month. Going over occasionally is fine; if it becomes the pattern, we'll reach out about moving you up a tier.

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between Open Source and the Pro plans?

acceptedAnswer.text: Open Source is the full framework, managed by you. Scale and Enterprise add the managed control plane (automatic updates, guaranteed uptime) plus the Model Control Plane, Artifact Control Plane, snapshots and Codespaces. Enterprise adds SSO, custom-role RBAC, audit logs and air-gapped deployment on top.

mainEntity.name: Is there a startup or academic discount?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Early-stage companies building ML-powered products, universities, research institutions and educational use cases can apply for special pricing on ZenML Pro. Apply here (/startups-and-academics).

ZenML is a metadata layer on top of your existing infrastructure: your data, artifacts and compute stay in your VPC, and only metadata reaches the control plane. ZenML is SOC 2 Type II and ISO/IEC 27001 certified.

mainEntity.name: Do I need a separate subscription for Kitaru?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, your ZenML subscription covers the Kitaru workspace too. Agents are priced on their own terms, from $39/month per agent rather than execution tiers, but both workspaces run on the same control plane and land on one bill.

mainEntity.name: What kind of support is included in each plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Open Source: our public Slack and community forums. Scale: priority support with faster response times. Enterprise: a dedicated account manager, SLAs, and implementation assistance.
